meta.title: parl · LRO Front and Cross-Service Orchestrator
meta.subtitle: MLE · system dia · periapical radiolucency, composed from two LRO services

views.label: Submit and poll
views.note: The front is the standard postgres-lro/lro setup, but the verbs are CreatePARL rather than Compute.

views.label: Two-stage fan-out
views.note: tooth-recognition runs first; its result becomes an input field of the parl-detection request.

views.label: No Python sidecar
views.note: This is one of two MLE workers with no compute container. All the ML work happens downstream.

cards.title: A composer, not a computer
items: parl-worker owns no model and ships no Python container in its pod
It claims a work item, then drives two other LRO services to completion
cbct-anatomy-segmentation-worker is the only other MLE worker built this way

cards.title: How the two stages join
items: trResponse.GetResult() becomes the ToothRecognition field of the stage 2 request
Both stages also receive the same CbctVolumeId and ComputeMetadata
Polling is strictly sequential, GetOperation every 500ms, no parallel fan-out

cards.title: Version mapping is a hard gate
items: worker.GetVersionMappings() resolves the requested semantic version per downstream
A missing mapping is a hard error, not a fallback to latest
The composed CreatePARLResponse is wrapped with anypb.New before it is stored

cards.title: Operations and drift
items: parl is DIA-021 at 300s and parl-worker is DIA-022, the longest dia LRO budget
The worker Deployment declares no resources block, so it is unbounded on the node
The result reuses the LRO operationID verbatim as ResultId under STORAGE_PARL
